title: Pattern-based Search of Epigenomic Data Using GeNemo
protocol: Specify a search range including the chromosome and base pair positions.
Use 'chrN' for the chromosome format, where 'N' is the chromosome number or letter (1, 2, ..., X, Y).
List the start base pair and end base pair numbers.
Include spaces between all three entries.
After clicking the data selection button, choose which types of tracks to search against.
Use the filter button to facilitate track selections by Experiment, Tissue, Cell Line and/or Lab.
Select tracks from the list for addition to the query.
Click the "Add" button to add currently selected tracks to the query using logic gate "OR".
Ensure that selecting filters does not automatically add corresponding tracks to the search query.
Only apply filters specified in the opened tab to the search query.
Save selections on other tabs in the filter window but do not apply them to the search query.
